annotations.title: List statements of a sitting day

description: List the statements (wypowiedzi) in the transcript (stenogram) of one day of a plenary sitting: statement number, speaker, function, MP ID and time. Get the text of a statement with get-statement.

date.description: Day of the sitting (one of the `dates` of the sitting in get-proceedings), in YYYY-MM-DD format

proceeding.description: Number of the plenary sitting (posiedzenie Sejmu): the `number` field from get-proceedings

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

name: get-transcripts

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

function.description: Speaker's function, e.g. Poseł or Minister

memberID.description: MP ID of the speaker, 0 if not an MP

num.description: Statement number, used by get-statement; 0 is the course of the sitting

title: List statements of a sitting day
